description: Board writes and per-agent tool scoping for the fleet. SessionStart names each BOARD_COL_* override in board.env that the board config does not list and clears the checkout's focus on every start but a compaction, so a focus from an earlier session never binds this one's spawns, SubagentStart moves the item to In Progress and binds nothing from a focus that names a Done item, SubagentStop writes Blocked by human, enforces the handoff format and leaves a stopped marker, matched to the fleet agents but the lead (the session agent, never spawned, whose type reaches SubagentStop only on the runtime's own side calls) so the gate never fires on a Plan or general-purpose lane or a side call - which is necessary but was never sufficient, since the workflows spawn fleet agents with schemas too, and those are told apart by their transcript rather than by their name, TaskCompleted gates on tests and writes Done or Blocked, PostToolUse on the Agent tool comments on the card of a bound fleet agent whose completed run left no stopped marker (a maxTurns cut-off never sends SubagentStop), and PreToolUse enforces the per-agent invariants that session-scoped permissions.deny cannot express, agent-clock.sh records when a capped agent (the refuter) starts and, on every tool call, denies each one past its hard cap and trims a Bash timeout to the time left, and enforce-disabled-agents.sh denies an Agent spawn of any type the project lists under disabledAgents in .claude/coder-fleet.json, reading the file on every call.
